# haziqbuilds — Syed Muhammad Haziq

> Freelance web developer based in Malaysia. Builds focused landing pages,
> sales pages and lightweight business websites for businesses, organisations
> and personal brands. Not currently taking on large custom systems or
> backend-heavy platforms.

## Services

- Landing Page: a focused one-page website for a business, campaign, service, event or personal brand.
- Sales Page: a conversion-focused page that explains one offer and pushes visitors toward one action.
- Business Website: a lightweight multi-section or small multi-page website for a stronger online presence.

## Pricing (starting prices, MYR)

- Starter: RM399+ — one-page responsive website, up to 5 main sections, WhatsApp/email call-to-action, mobile optimisation, basic SEO setup, 1 revision round.
- Sales / Business: RM799+ — custom page structure, conversion-focused sections, contact or enquiry form, analytics setup, 2 revision rounds.
- Custom Front-End: quote on request — custom visual direction, multiple marketing pages, interactive UI where useful; scope agreed before work begins.

Final pricing depends on content, design complexity and scope.

- Founder & Developer, KadMeHQ (2026 – present).
- Web Developer Intern, Mysoftcare Solution (Oct 2023 – Mar 2024).
